description: macFUSE on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. macFUSE (formerly OSXFUSE) is the FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace) framework for macOS, distributed as a DMG containing a .pkg installer. install_macfuse.sh downloads the latest stable macFUSE release from the official macfuse/macfuse GitHub repo and installs via `sudo installer -pkg`. The installer drops the macFUSE bundle at /Library/Filesystems/macfuse.fs/, the userspace library at /usr/local/lib/libfuse2.dylib (+ libfuse.dylib symlink), C headers under /usr/local/include/fuse/, and the mount helper at /Library/Filesystems/macfuse.fs/Contents/Resources/mount_macfuse. The macFUSE kernel extension / system extension itself requires Apple-approved user gestures (System Settings approval + Reduced Security in Recovery) to actually LOAD on Apple Silicon, which the use.computer base-macos image cannot satisfy automatically — tasks here therefore focus on inspecting / auditing the installed-on-disk macFUSE artifacts rather than driving live FUSE mounts. Verifiers parse Info.plist, run `pkgutil --pkg-info`, `stat`, `file` against the installed bundle — no AX over SSH (TCC blocks `tell System Events`).
